p0.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi left hand sliding square gives you both 90 degree and 45 degree settings in one fence. It runs in the groove of the saw's cutting table and flips between square and mitre, so you can go from straight cuts to diagonal cuts on a 45 degree lay without changing tools. It is Raimondi part 192SQ07A.

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe Advanced (85A, 105A, 130A and 155A)
  • Raimondi Pikus Advanced (85, 105 and 130)
  • Raimondi SMS 100 and SMS 125
  • Raimondi Exploit, Bolt and Mistral bridge saws

Specifications

  • Settings: 45 and 90 degrees
  • Left hand
  • Size: 29 x 22 x 7 cm
  • Weight: about 900 g
  • Model: 192SQ07A

Good to know

  • Pair it with the right hand version to work from either side of the blade.
  • Check the 45 degree setting against a known square before cutting a run of diagonals.
  • Rinse grit out of the table groove so the square keeps sliding freely.

p1.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi right hand sliding square is the mirror of the left hand 45/90 square. It runs in the groove of the cutting table and flips between a 90 degree and a 45 degree fence, so you can set up mitre and square cuts on the right side of the blade. With one of each you can work from either side without walking around the saw.

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe Advanced (85A, 105A, 130A and 155A)
  • Raimondi Pikus Advanced (85, 105 and 130)
  • Raimondi SMS 100 and SMS 125

Specifications

  • Settings: 45 and 90 degrees
  • Right hand

Good to know

  • The left hand version (Raimondi 192SQ07A) is listed separately. Most tilers keep both on the saw.
  • Check the 45 degree stop against a known square before cutting a run of diagonals.
  • Rinse grit out of the table groove at the end of the day so the square keeps sliding freely.

p2.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 200 mm continuous rim diamond blade for clean, chip free cuts in ceramic tile on small bridge saws. The continuous rim is the blade for glazed wall tiles and anything where the cut edge will be seen. Wet use only.

Use it for

  • Ceramic and porcelain wall and floor tiles
  • Clean visible cuts on 200 mm wet saws

Specifications

  • Diameter: 200 mm
  • Bore: 25.4 mm
  • Rim height: 7 mm
  • Continuous rim, wet cutting

Fits

  • Raimondi Exploit 70, 90 and 120
  • Other 200 mm bridge saws with a 25.4 mm bore

Good to know

  • Too small for the Zoe, Pikus, SMS and SA 80, which take 250 mm and larger blades.
  • Keep the water flowing over the blade. A continuous rim run dry glazes over and stops cutting.
  • Raimondi also makes a 200 mm economy continuous rim blade with a 10 mm rim for everyday ceramic work.

p3.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 200 mm economy continuous rim diamond blade for cutting ceramic tile on small bridge saws. It is the everyday blade for standard glazed ceramics: a continuous rim for a clean edge, with a tall 10 mm rim for plenty of blade life. Wet use only.

Use it for

  • Ceramic wall and floor tiles
  • General cutting on 200 mm wet saws

Specifications

  • Diameter: 200 mm
  • Bore: 25.4 mm
  • Rim height: 10 mm
  • Continuous rim, wet cutting
  • Raimondi lists it as Art. 179CC200E

Fits

  • Raimondi Exploit 70, 90 and 120
  • Other 200 mm bridge saws with a 25.4 mm bore

Good to know

  • Too small for the Zoe, Pikus, SMS and SA 80.
  • For hard porcelain, step up to Raimondi's standard 200 mm continuous rim blade.
  • Keep the water on and feed steadily. Forcing the cut heats the rim and shortens its life.

p4.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 300 mm continuous rim diamond blade for clean cuts in ceramic tile on bridge wet saws. The continuous rim leaves a smooth, chip free edge on glazed tile, and the 10 mm rim gives a long working life. It comes with a 30 mm bore and a reducer to 25.4 mm, so it fits most 300 mm saws. Wet use only.

Use it for

  • Ceramic and porcelain tiles
  • Visible cuts where edge quality matters

Specifications

  • Diameter: 300 mm
  • Bore: 30 / 25.4 mm
  • Rim height: 10 mm
  • Continuous rim, wet cutting
  • Raimondi lists it as Art. 179CC300CAF

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe Advanced (all sizes)
  • Raimondi SMS 100 and SMS 125
  • Raimondi SA 80
  • Any other saw that takes a 300 to 350 mm blade with a 25.4 mm bore

Good to know

  • Keep the water flowing. A continuous rim run dry glazes over and stops cutting.
  • For granite and marble use the segmented granite blade instead.

p5.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 350 mm continuous rim diamond blade for ceramic tile on bridge wet saws. Going up to 350 mm gives the Zoe and SMS their full depth of cut, so you can get through thick porcelain, pavers and stepped cuts in one pass while still leaving a clean edge. Wet use only.

Use it for

  • Ceramic and porcelain tiles, including 20 mm outdoor pavers
  • Deep cuts where the 300 mm blade runs out of depth

Specifications

  • Diameter: 350 mm
  • Bore: 30 / 25.4 mm
  • Rim height: 7 mm
  • Continuous rim, wet cutting

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe Advanced (all sizes)
  • Raimondi SMS 100 and SMS 125
  • Raimondi SA 80
  • Any other saw that takes a 300 to 350 mm blade with a 25.4 mm bore

Good to know

  • With a 350 mm blade the Zoe Advanced cuts 110 mm deep and the SMS 100 mm deep in one pass.
  • Keep the water flowing and feed hard porcelain slowly.
  • Not for the Pikus Advanced, which takes 230 to 250 mm blades.

p6.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 350 mm turbo rim diamond blade for fast cutting of ceramic tile on bridge wet saws. The turbo rim has a serrated edge that clears slurry and cuts quicker than a plain continuous rim, so it suits production work where speed matters more than a polished edge. Wet use only.

Use it for

  • Fast cutting of ceramic and porcelain tiles
  • Pavers and thicker material where you want the full 350 mm depth

Specifications

  • Diameter: 350 mm
  • Bore: 25.4 mm
  • Rim height: 7 mm
  • Turbo rim, wet cutting

Fits

  • Raimondi Zoe Advanced (all sizes)
  • Raimondi SMS 100 and SMS 125
  • Raimondi SA 80
  • Any other saw that takes a 300 to 350 mm blade with a 25.4 mm bore

Good to know

  • A turbo rim can leave a slightly rougher edge than a continuous rim on glazed porcelain. Use the continuous rim blade for cuts that will show.
  • Keep the water on. Dry running shortens the life of any diamond blade.

p7.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi 250 mm economy segmented diamond blade for porcelain and ceramic tile on the Pikus Advanced and other 250 mm wet saws. Raimondi's segmented ceramic discs use closely spaced J-slot segments, which cool and clear slurry better than a continuous rim while still cutting cleanly through hard porcelain. Wet use only.

Use it for

  • Porcelain and ceramic floor and wall tiles
  • Everyday cutting on the Pikus Advanced

Specifications

  • Diameter: 250 mm
  • Segmented (J-slot) rim for ceramic
  • Economy grade
  • Wet cutting

Fits

  • Raimondi Pikus Advanced 85, 105 and 130 (230 to 250 mm blades)
  • Other 250 mm wet saws with a 25.4 mm bore

Good to know

  • Too small for the Zoe, SMS and SA 80, which take 300 mm and larger blades.
  • For the cleanest edge on polished porcelain, Raimondi's 250 mm multilayer slotted rim blade is the step up.
  • Keep the water flowing and let the blade do the work on hard tile.
